title: Glossary
desc: Core terms across the neurons.me ecosystem — O(k), axiomatic integrity, stealth-root, monad, netget, NRP, encrypted audiences and more.

title: Stealth-Root — Glossary
desc: A path-native encryption scope where the root of a private branch resolves to undefined by design.

title: Structural Silence — Glossary
desc: A branch that exists and works but exposes no metadata, markers or prefixes in the public index.

title: Stealth Tax — Glossary
desc: The relative latency overhead of secret-path resolution compared to public-path resolution.

title: Secret Epoch — Glossary
desc: A monotonic version marker for security topology; caches are invalidated atomically when it changes.

title: Identity Noise (~) — Glossary
desc: The ~() operator: a boundary that cuts inherited secret lineage without removing the identity dependency.

title: Inverted Dependency Indexing — Glossary
desc: State changes propagate only through active upward dependency chains — no polling, no global state manager.

title: Algorithmic Runtime Invariance (O(k)) — Glossary
desc: Query and resolution cost depends on path depth k, not on total data volume n.

title: Axiomatic Integrity — Glossary
desc: Kernel-level enforcement of the .me axioms (A-struct-0, A0–A9) so every transition is deterministic and verifiable.

title: True Lazy Write — Glossary
desc: Writes do only an O(1) version update; recomputation is deferred to read-time validation.

title: Push vs Pull — Glossary
desc: Split between write-path (push) and first-read-after-mutation (pull) cost, to see where latency enters.

title: Differential Indexing — Glossary
desc: Incremental index maintenance: only changed paths are updated, no global rebuild on write.

title: Chunked Secret Storage — Glossary
desc: Encrypted data split into deterministic chunks so crypto cost stays local to the touched segment.

title: Collective Alias Collapse — Glossary
desc: Different labels converge on one operational meaning through structural alignment and pointers.

title: Binary Geometry — Glossary
desc: Identity and meaning as emergent properties of a graph's structure and relations.

title: Deterministic Portability — Glossary
desc: Exported snapshots and replays rebuild equivalent state and outputs on any machine.

title: Criteria Invariance — Glossary
desc: Interpretation criteria act as operators over data and never alter the observed data.

title: Encrypted Island — Glossary
desc: I = (path, ciphertext, T, A, P): topology, audience and capability sets that define private, shared, public, replicated and distributed data.

title: monad (monad.ai) — Glossary
desc: A federated runtime holding one .me kernel, started from a SEED; the reference implementation of NRP.

title: NRP (Namespace Resolution Protocol) — Glossary
desc: How a me:// name and a path inside it resolve to a value across the mesh.

title: Disclosure Levels — Glossary
desc: public, closed, stealth or contested: what the kernel reveals when an NRP channel resolves.
